WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) as total_telescopes,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) FROM telescopes) as total_observatories
)
SELECT 
  tc.observstation,
  tc.telescope_count,
  CAST(tc.telescope_count AS REAL) / t.total_telescopes as share,
  CAST(tc.telescope_count AS REAL) / t.total_telescopes - 1.0 / t.total_observatories as above_average_diff
FROM telescope_counts tc, totals t
WHERE CAST(tc.telescope_count AS REAL) / t.total_telescopes > 1.0 / t.total_observatories
ORDER BY above_average_diff DESC
LIMIT 10
